CREATE TABLE "public"."currency" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "decimalPlaces" int4 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("code")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."exchangeQuote" (
  "amount" numeric(18,6) NOT NULL,
  "consumedAt" timestamptz,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "fee" numeric(18,6) NOT NULL,
  "fromCurrency" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lockedRate" numeric(18,10) NOT NULL,
  "toCurrency" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."exchangeRate" (
  "baseCurrency" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quoteCurrency" text NOT NULL,
  "rate" numeric(18,10) NOT NULL,
  "validFrom" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "validTo" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."transaction" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "destinationAmount" numeric(18,6) NOT NULL,
  "exchangeRate" numeric(18,10) NOT NULL,
  "fee" numeric(18,6) NOT NULL,
  "fromCurrency" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "quoteId" uuid,
  "sourceAmount" numeric(18,6) NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "toCurrency" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "transaction_status_check_04ef721f" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED')),
  CONSTRAINT "transaction_type_check_71a5d00a" CHECK ("type" IN ('EXCHANGE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."wallet" (
  "balance" numeric(18,6) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currencyCode" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
